description: The Seele theme contract. Every styling value the desktop shell and Seele Notes draw with is a slot here, implemented once by Theme.qml in the same order and with the same defaults; tests/theme-contract.js holds the two to each other and fails on any styling literal outside them.

documents.description: A theme is a JSON object: its identity, then any slots it supplies by name. It must supply every required slot. Any other slot it leaves out takes its default, which reproduces the shell as it was drawn before themes could set more than colours; sound and wallpaper slots fall back as their slots say. Derived slots are computed from the slots they name and fixed slots belong to the contract, so a theme supplies neither, except a derived colour marked suppliable, which a theme may give in place of its derivation. An easing slot is BezierSpline exactly when the theme gives the curve slot beside it. Keys listed in extensions are not styling and are passed through: the Base16 `palette` and `terminal` colours other applications take from a theme, the publication format `version` they check, and `material`, the seed and contrast a Material 3 Expressive theme was grown from, which registration grows again and compares.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, as `seele-theme` names a preset.

name.description: The name the switcher and the Themes panel show.

documents.paths: A path slot holds an absolute path or the empty string. A theme folder names its own files relative to itself; registration resolves them to absolute paths before the shell sees them.

types.color: #rrggbb, or #aarrggbb with alpha first as Qt reads it.
types.int: An integer: pixels, milliseconds or a count, as the slot says.
types.real: A finite number: an opacity, a ratio or a fractional pixel size.
types.string: Text, such as a font family.
types.path: An absolute file path, or empty for none.
types.outputPaths: An object from output names, as the compositor names them (letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, at most 64), to absolute file paths; empty for none.
types.url: A URL resolved against the shell's own files.
types.weight: A font weight, by its name in `enums.weight`.
types.easing: An easing curve, by its name in `enums.easing`.
types.curve: A cubic Bézier easing curve as Qt's easing.bezierCurve reads it: control points x1, y1, x2, y2 and the end point of each segment, six numbers a segment and at most eight segments, ending at 1, 1. Empty while its easing is a named curve; its easing is BezierSpline exactly when it is not empty.
types.capitalization: A capitalization, by its name in `enums.capitalization`.

fallbacks.sound: Silence. An omitted or empty sound slot plays nothing.
fallbacks.wallpaper: The image the host's wallpaper mapping chooses for the theme by its light or dark mode and by output, else the configured wallpaper, which the publication names for a theme without an image of its own, so switching to it keeps the image on screen; before any theme is published, $SEELE_SHELL_WALLPAPER when the session sets it, else /etc/wallpaper/wallpaper.jpg. Either is drawn over the base colour, so a missing file still leaves the palette.
fallbacks.assets: Nothing loaded. An omitted or empty typeface file loads nothing, so `fontFamily` names a typeface installed on the system; an omitted or empty surface texture keeps the shell's grain film.

structural.description: Numbers that describe structure rather than style, which a surface may still write: they are what any theme would want there. Anything else bound to a geometry, type, shape, material or motion property is a slot.
values: zero: no gap, no stroke, hidden
an integer count that multiplies or divides a measure: both sides of a card, the columns of a grid, the rows a list shows, the gaps between n items
a half: the middle of a span, the centre of a gradient, a circle's radius as half its size
one as the full strength of an opacity, scale or gradient end, as the unit clamp of Math.max or Math.min, or as an empty or full channel of Qt.rgba
a full turn, 360, as the end of a rotation animation
a comparison, an index or a remainder: logic about the data
"transparent": no paint at all, such as a layer window's own background
structural.artwork: Drawing coordinates of an icon or an illustration -- the headphone silhouettes, the theme switcher's miniature desktops, the speed gauge's dial -- are marked `theme-contract: artwork` in the source with their reason. They are sized by a slot and coloured from slots, and the check lists them.

members.description: Theme.qml properties that are not styling values and so not slots. Each is declared after the helper functions; any other property anywhere in Theme.qml must be a slot.
members.keyboardNavigation: The shared keyboard navigation every surface reaches through the theme (projects/navigation).
members.supplied: The derived slots the published theme supplies in place of their derivations, by slot (Contract.supplied), easings as Qt enums; a suppliable slot reads it before its derivation.
members.motionEnabled: Whether a theme's own motion plays: the user's choice, not the theme's, read from the theme helper's preferences (seele-theme motion on|off); on by default.
members.soundEnabled: Whether a theme's interface sounds play: the user's choice, read from the theme helper's preferences (seele-theme sound on|off); off by default.
members.panelMotion: Whether the published theme moves its panels (a cut, trimmed panel with a sweep or a glitch flicker), so the motion choice is offered only for a theme that has motion.
members.themeSounds: Whether the published theme carries any sound cue, so the sound choice is offered and the player loaded only for a theme that has one.

A panel is translucent, so a card on it is a tint of the same material rather than an opaque block, a row inside that card is a lighter tint again, and a track or well is cut back to the ink.
